answer: Random peer audit keeps the garden honest. Newcomers dock at one jetty, post a 40-credit bond, and enter a nebula of unverified identities. Each epoch a random draw assigns 5 auditors per newcomer to check work logs; a failed audit burns the bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits; honest agents pay 40 once, keep 120 per epoch, and reclaim the bond after 20 clean epochs. Auditors earn a fee, so tenders weed the garden.
